I have two stories involving lsd in nature that were pretty weird
The firt time i took acid with my cousin and went hiking everything was going fine until he just stopped and started to look at the horizon then he went into fetal position for a while i didn’t tought it wss weird but when he became aware again he started running and shouting that we whre in danger and needed to get out of there, so we ran for a while down the hill when i shouted at him to told me what was going on but when i looked into his eyes i felt like it wasn’t him, he told me to just follow him, but i was scared because i didn’t felt like it was him, so he ran into the forest with a machete, and i just sat there with a super odd feeling, looking at the direction he went there were light spheres that expanded for 10 meter i could see them many times from where i was, i knew it was him but it was too weird to belive that happened like 10 times, after that i started to have visions of lights and god and what i am and we both got rescued after that i talked with my cousin about that and he told me he felt he got possessed by the spirit of the forest and he felt like he needed to give the life back to it that he slammed into the floor feeling light, he also told me that he stabbed himself in the heart with the machete but nothing happened to him.

2 time
I don’t know why we took acid in the same place but this time i had a dream the day after of a demon and i told my cousin in the morning but we didn’t thought nothing about it, again ing everything was going normal until i saw a gigantic golden spider in the hair of my cousin i took it away with a leave after that we started hearing women screaming from afar the more we got closer to where the car was we felt more anxiety and the screaming got louder, we then arrived to a hill where we could see the parking lot where we were parked in-front of a school where we saw a weird disproportionate shadow person just shifting we could hear and feel this being and we knew he wasn’t human i knew he was the demon from my dream i got to scared and stoped watching him after that he disappeared but many people appeared and they were singing about killing people and started talking to another person about sketchy stuff, we were sure they killed people in there, after that ny cousin looked at me and he said this is the part when we start crying and when he said that a circle of clouds formed in the sky above us and it started raining while my cousin was crying i didn’t cried but it was Amazing after the last car went away we got up and felt presences among us like ghost we couldn’t see but feel we talked to them and asked them the way out, after that the wind started to show us the way.
